contexts.text: See Walk.
Perception (is) by an internal way... doctrine, by an external way...
All flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth () = that the Corporeal of man had destroyed all the understanding of truth... Way = the understanding of truth, or the Truth itself. Illustrated.
Way, and paths = the truths of faith. AC 1298:end. AC 2761.
Instruction is merely an opening of the way...
Speech enters by an external way; but that of Spirits... by an internal way. HH 248.
When being carried by the Spirit there is no reflection upon the way... and the man is led through ways he is ignorant about.
Intellectual truth... inflows through an internal way...
Scientifics and Knowledges... inflow by an external way... AC 2632.
In the way to Shur () = the things which proceed from scientifics... A way = that which leads to truth, and that which proceeds from truth.
Way = truth. AC 3923:6. AC 9144:6.
To keep the way of Jehovah () = the doctrine by which they are instructed, (and which) is from Him.

That way = doctrine, is evident from the signification of a way. A way, in the Word, is predicated of truths, because truths lead to good, and proceed from good; and, as a way is predicated of these, a way = doctrine, because doctrine comprehends in one complex all the things which lead to good, that is, to charity.
Ye shall... go on your way () = confirmation in truth. Explained, Illustrated.
The Lord is doctrine itself, and therefore is called the Way, etc. AC 2531:4.
These things are effected by the way of the body, that is, by an external way...
His Divine Rational was not born by an external way, which is that of the senses, as His former Rational was; but by an internal way from the Divine Itself.
When man is regenerate, the Lord inflows by an internal way, that is, by the good of conscience.
This (opening of the eyes) is effected by an influx... through the way of the soul, or the internal way, unknown to the man. This is his state of enlightenment...
Him shall He teach in the way that He shall choose () = in the truth.

For there are two ways which lead into the rational mind... a higher or internal way, through which there enters good and truth from the Lord; and a lower or external way, through which there comes up evil and falsity from Hell; and the rational mind itself is in the middle position to which the two ways tend. HH 430. (Compare AE 208:3, below.)
The ways of Zion do mourn () = that there are no longer any truths from good. ( = that Divine truths are no longer sought. AE 863:2.)

The good of life, or the affection of good, is insinuated by the Lord through an internal way, unknown to the man; but the truth of doctrine, or faith, through an external way... into the memory. AC 3098. AC 3324. AC 3995:2. AC 6269:2.
To know whether Jehovah had prospered his way, or not () = inquiry concerning Divine truth. Way = truth.

I being in the way () = in a state of the conjunction of truth in the Rational... for this is the subject here treated of. Way = truth. And a person is said to be in the way, when he is advancing to where he intends to go.
All good inflows by an internal way, or by the way of the soul...
Prepare ye the way of Jehovah () (and other similar passages) = to prepare one's self for the reception of truth. Explained.
Man has to learn all truth by an external way through this way must truth be insinuated...
Jehovah hath prospered my way () = that all things were now provided... as to the truth that was to be conjoined with good; for way = truth.
Some fell on the hard way () = into falsity, (See DLife 90, below.)

There were represented... a broad way which led to Hell, and a narrow way which led to Heaven. Described. The Spirits were asked which way they wanted to go. They said. The broad way. But their eyes were suddenly opened, and they saw the serpents in the broad way, and the Angels in the narrow way... SE 4216.

Doctrinal things, or the Knowledges of good and truth, cannot be communicated to the natural man except by means of delights... accommodated to it; for they are insinuated through an external or sensuous way.
The rough ways shall become smooth () = that the falsities of ignorance [shall be turned] into truths.
They wandered in the wilderness, in a solitude of a way () = those who are in ignorance of good and in ignorance of truth. ( = in a penury of the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 223:5.)
When man suffers himself to be illuminated by the Word... an internal way is opened, and thus an influx... from the Lord; (otherwise) the internal way is closed...
He set away of three days () = completely separated. AC 6904, Explained.
A way of seven days () = what is holy of truth.
Way = truth in will and act.
In the Most Ancient Church... the Lord inflowed by an internal way into the good of their will, and through this into their... truth. AC 4489:3.
But with the Ancient Church, the Lord could not inflow by an internal, but by an external way... AC 4493:2.

To see goods by an internal or prior way (as in the Most Ancient Church) is like seeing in the day... whereas to see by an external or posterior way (as in the Christian Church) is like seeing in the night...
They who are led... to good by an internal way, are in the good of love; but they who are led by an external way, are in the good of faith.
These (spiritual) odours inflow by an internal way.
The good which Esau represents inflowed by an internal way... but that which Jacob and Israel represents inflowed by an external way...
The speech of Spirits inflows into my ear by an internal way; but human speech, by an external way.
The way () = falsity. AC 4891.
Way is predicated of truth; and, in the opposite sense, of falsity.
For truth inflows by an external or sensuous way; but good, by an internal way; and that which inflows by an external way is felt by the man; but not that which inflows by an internal way.

(Intelligence and wisdom) are effected in man... by an internal way and by an external way; the Divine inflows by an internal way, and what is of the world by an external way; and they meet in the man...
As evil closes the way, and prevents the influx of good and truth...
To pasture upon the ways () = to be instructed in truths. AC 6078:2.
In so far as man suffers himself to be regenerated, there is insinuated by the Lord, into the Natural, by an internal way, the light of truth from good.

To give them provision on the way () = support for the truths they had... Way = truth: but here, on the way = so long as they were in that state; for to be on the way = a state of truth conjoined with good.
By the way () = meanwhile.
Dan a serpent on the way () = their reasoning about truth... AC 3923:2.
In the way () = what is instituted. (Explained.)

Thus the way by which the good of charity enters is called an internal way; and the way by which the truth of faith enters, an external way; and that which enters by an internal way is not perceived... AC 7910:end.
When Angels are about to come, a Spirit is sent to prepare the way... So John the Baptist prepared the way. SE 1656.

Faith merely natural is... insinuated by an external way... But spiritual faith is that which is insinuated by an internal and an external way at the same time. Insinuation by an internal way causes it to be believed, and then that which is insinuated by an external way causes it to be confirmed... The insinuation of faith by an internal way is effected by the reading of the Word, accompanied by enlightenment from the Lord...
The way of the land of the Philistines () = a passing to the truth of faith which is not from good... Way = truth; here, to pass to it.
The way of the wilderness () = to undergo temptations, thus to confirm the truths and goods of faith.
To lead them in the way () being said of Jehovah's leading, = Providence, and the Divine auspices.
The man with whom the Divine influx goes (down to the ultimate of order) may be called a way of Heaven.
Not doing thine own ways () = not acting from proprium. ( = not to favour the falsities of evil. AC 10362.)
All the travail that had come upon them by the way () = labour in temptations... For the way (here) is the wilderness.

Thou shalt make known to them the way wherein they must walk () = the light of intelligence, and the derivative life; for way is predicated of the understanding of truth; here, in an interior degree...
That the truths of faith had failed and been perverted, is signified by, the ways ceased, and the travellers walked through crooked ways ().
The belly corresponds to the way towards Hell.

The truth of the literal sense... is received by an external way, that is, through the hearing... and the internal man chooses and calls forth from it the truths which agree with the good which inflows from the Lord by the way of the soul...
The multitude spread their garments in the way () because by a way is signified the truth by means of which the man of the Church is led.
For the truths of faith enter by an external way and store themselves in the memory... But the good of charity inflows by an internal way from Heaven...

The external way is through the hearing (and sight) into the memory, and from the memory into its understanding... The truths which must be of faith enter by this way, to the end that they may be introduced into the will... The good which inflows from the Lord by the internal way, inflows into the will... and there meets the truths... AC 9995:3. AC 10047:3.
This is the way, walk ye in it () = in the truth of doctrine, and the good of life. ( = instruction and obedience. Way = truth leading. AE 600:11.)

To keep (or guard) thee in the way () = His Providence and guardianship from the falsities of evil... Way, here, = falsity, as well as truth, because it is said to guard, and he who leads in truth also guards from falsity... and it is the falsity of evil which infests and assaults truth.
Way = truth seen and revealed. References.
To lead in the way () = to teach truth. See AE 654:60.
They have departed quickly from the way which I commanded them () = that they had removed themselves from Divine truth.

That a way = truth, is derived from the appearance in the Spiritual World; for there, also, there appear ways and paths; and as Spirits go only to those with whom they have been consociated by love, their quality as to truth is known from the way in which they go; for all truth leads to its own love... Hence it is that even in common speech, a way means truth... And hence also it is that, in the Word, by way, path, track, street, are signified truths; and, in the opposite sense, falsities. Illustrated. HH 496:end. SE 5485.
Make known to me Thy way, that I may Know Thee () = instruction about the Divine as to its quality... The way of Jehovah = the Divine truth leading.
The way (there) is lengthened or shortened according to the desire, although it is the same. DLW 74.

These loves, with their delights, inflow from the Lord... by an internal way, which leads from above... whereas the other loves, with their delights, inflow from the flesh and the world by an external way, which leads from below. HH 400:3.
There is no approach to any heavenly Society, except by a narrow way, the entrance to which is guarded.
To every heavenly Society... there is one way from the World of Spirits, which branches into a number as it rises.

Ways appear in the World of Spirits, some of which lead to Heaven, and some to Hell; each way leads to some Society. Good Spirits walk in those ways only which lead to Heaven, to that Society which is in the good of their love, and they do not see ways which lead elsewhere; whereas evil Spirits walk in those ways only which lead to Hell, to that Society which is in the evil of their love, and do not see ways which lead elsewhere; or, if they see them, they do not want to go in them. Such ways there are real appearances, which correspond either to truths or to falsities; and therefore in the Word, ways = these. HH 590:2. DLW 145. DP 60. AR 176.

After (this) instruction, the Spirits... are brought to a way which leads upwards to Heaven, and are delivered over to the Angel guards there... Afterwards each one is led by the Lord into his own Society, and this too through various ways... The ways through which they are led are known to no Angel, but to the Lord alone.

There are eight ways (which lead to Heaven from the places of instruction), two from each place; one ascends towards the east, and the other to the west. They who come into the Celestial Kingdom are introduced by the eastern way; and they who come into the Spiritual Kingdom, by the western way. The four ways which lead to the Celestial Kingdom appear adorned with olives and other fruit trees... and those which lead to the Spiritual Kingdom, with vines and laurels. Explained.

There was (seen) a broad way tending to the left, or north, with many Spirits going on it, and which terminated at a large stone, from which two ways diverged, one to the left, and one opposite, to the right, the former being narrow, and leading through the west into the south, and thus into the light of Heaven; and the latter broad, and leading obliquely downwards towards Hell. At first all seemed to go on the same way, until they came to the great stone... where the good turned to the left... but the evil fell over the stone... and then ran on in the broad way. (This representation Fully explained.) SE 5798, Explained.
Those thoughts of man which proceed from intention or will, are there represented by ways... and everyone walks in accordance therewith.

(This shows) what is meant by... broad is the way that leadeth to destruction, and many there are who walk by it; and narrow is the way... that leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it (). The reason the way that leads to life is narrow, is not because it is difficult, but because few find it.
This is why ways, in the Word, = the truths which lead to good; and, in the opposite sense, the falsities which lead to evil.

In the Spiritual World, the ways in which anyone walks, are the actual determinations of the thoughts of his mind; and hence it is that ways, walkings, and the like, in the Word, = the determinations and progressions of spiritual life.
All enlightenment... enters man by an internal way.
He was then seen to wander through ways in thought... but whenever he arrived at the end of the way, his eyes were opened, and he saw that he was wandering... I saw him so wandering for two years.
Some seed fell upon the way () = with those who do [not] care for truth. ( = Divine truth received solely by the corporeal sensuous. AE 632:end.) ( = received in the memory only. AE 740:end.)

Heaven is given to those only who know the way to it, and walk therein. This way may in some measure be known from a Knowledge of the quality of those who constitute Heaven... In the Angelic there is a Knowledge of the way from walking in it, and a walking in the way through the Knowledge of it.

In the Spiritual World... every person sees his own way as of himself; the reason of which is that there are ways there for every love, and the love opens its own way, and leads to its consociates. No one sees any other ways than the one of his love; from which it is evident that Angels are nothing but heavenly loves; for otherwise they would not have seen the ways which lead to Heaven. DP 319:end.
The Lord enters man by no other way than an internal way, which is through the Word, and doctrine and preachings from it; and miracles close this way.
The three then entered together the way of self-prudence, which leads into Hell. (Compare CL 354:end.)
Their eyes are then opened, and they see a way which leads to some cavern.
Under Street, see this reference.

Their eyes are then opened, and they see a way which leads to some Society in Heaven. They enter this way, and ascend, and in the ascent there is a gate, and a guard at it, who opens the gate, and they pass in... TCR 622.

Just and true are Thy ways () = that all things which proceed from Him are just and true... Ways = truths which lead to good. ( = that all the truths of Heaven and the Church are from Him... For, when predicated of the Lord, ways = all the truths of Heaven and the Church. AE 940.)

That the way of the kings from the rising of the sun might be prepared () = those who, from the Lord, are in truths from good... To prepare the way = to prepare for introduction. ( = that the Divine truth might inflow from the Lord. For way = influx, because all influx from one Society to another is through ways opened in the Spiritual World. AE 997.)
When (Spirits) have been prepared, they see ways opened to them to Societies of their like... and they hen enter these ways with delight, because they are the ways of their love.
(The angel husband and wife) were conveyed in a chariot by a paved way between flower-beds...
The way was shortened and anticipated by the changes of state induced on our minds in accordance with the genius of the inhabitants through whom we passed.

There are three places where... such things are examined into... In one of them a way into Heaven is open to all, but when they arrive there, they themselves perceive their own quality as to the acknowledgement of God. In the second there is also a way open into Heaven, but no one can enter that way unless he has Heaven in himself. And in the third place there is a way to Hell, and they who love infernal things enter this way of their own accord, because from delight. We judges consign to these places all who request judgment from us about Heaven and Hell. (The experiences of some at these three places described.)

The faith of God enters man by a prior way, which is from the soul into the higher things of the understanding; whereas Knowledges about God enter by a posterior way, because they are imbibed from the revealed Word by the understanding through the senses of the body; and in the middle of the understanding there is a meeting of the influxes...

At last (these Spirits who were in merely natural loves) came to a way in which the delights of these loves breathed on them, and they said. Let us go this way. They did so, and descended, and at last came to those who were in the delights of the like loves... and became demons.

I saw in the north a paved way, crowded with Spirits... and I had heard that this is the way through which all pass who depart from the natural world... This way is terminated in the middle (of the World of Spirits). Explained.
There are two ways into the human understanding: a way through the senses... and a way through Heaven from the Lord. Explained.
That those who want to injure the innocent... quickly betake themselves to a way at the back, towards Hell. Explained.
Brutes have a sense not possessed by man, namely, of knowing the way. Explained.
On the ways by which Souls ascend from the Lower Earth into the World of Spirits.
They are also thrust down through ways...
Still, these are in a good way... for they love uses.
But these are represented as being in an evil way...
These things [were written] on the way. SE 3424. SE 3425. SE 3426. SE 3427.
Under Walk, see this reference. SE 5863. AE 97.
b. They induce ways and streets by phantasies...
Ways both without and within (between the upper and lower cities). Explained.

That the way which leads to Heaven is the same way (for all) as far as the corner stone. Explained... I spoke with the Angels about its being believed that it is difficult to go the way to Heaven... and therefore it was shown by a way. (See HH 534.)
All Spirits, after vastation, are now led through ways which lead to the Societies of their life... and are not allowed to stray from them. SE 5872.

Spirits are allowed to go along the ways which they see, and each one sees a way in accordance with his affection and the derivative thought; yet many ways are stopped up with bars, because if they walked in them those below and those above would suffer... for the lower and higher things have been so ordinated... that there is a mediate influx also from the higher ones into the lower.
How Spirits are explored by the ways in which they go.
Spirits are led through various ways... before they come to their own corresponding place...
That ways, in the Word, = truths, or falsities. Illustrated.

The donkey turned three times out of the way () = that an enlightened understanding did not accord with the thought of a sorcerer, which is meant also by what the Angel said... I went forth to withstand thee, because thy way is evil before me (). By way is signified that which a man thinks from intention.
To give every man according to his ways () = [according to] his truths that are of faith.

When a (Spirit) is in such a state that he can be admitted into Heaven, there appears to him a way that leads to the heavenly Society in which he is to be; and until he is in this state the way thither does not appear to him. This way is opened to him by the Lord alone. (The same with an evil Spirit.) The reason is, that, in the Spiritual World, ways appear to each person according to the intention of his thought, and thus according to the affection of his love. So that when a Spirit has been brought to his reigning love... ways appear to the Society where his love reigns.

Two ways lead to the Rational of man; one from Heaven, and the other from the world. Good is introduced through the way from Heaven, and truth through the way from the world. In proportion as the way from Heaven has been opened in a man, in the same proportion he is affected with truth, and becomes rational, that is, in the same proportion he sees truth from the light of truth. But if the way from Heaven has been closed, the man does not become rational. Explained... To think aright about the Lord and the neighbour opens the way from Heaven; but to think not aright about (them) closes this way.
He led them also into a straight way () = into genuine truth. AE 730:37.
I will lead the blind into a way that they have not known; I will lead them into paths that they have not known () = the truths and the goods of truth which they will receive.
The wayfarer hath ceased () = no longer any truths of faith.
That your ways may be laid waste () = that they will be deprived of truths; for ways = the truths which lead to good.
See Pass through.
Ye have turned aside out of the way () = that the Israelitish Church has perverted the truths of the Word. Way = the truths of doctrine. ( = to live contrary to Divine truth. AE 701:9.)

The stars from their courses fought against Sisera () = combat by means of the Knowledges of truth and good which come from the Lord through Heaven; the stars = these Knowledges, and courses (or ways) = truths.
I will even make a way in the wilderness () = that there shall be truth where there was none before.

In the Spiritual World there are ways that lead to Hell, and ways that lead to Heaven, and there are also ways that lead from spiritual things to natural and thence to sensuous things; and there are guards in the ways to prevent anyone from going in the contrary direction, for he would thus fall into heresies and errors. These guards are placed there at the beginning of the establishment of a Church... to prevent the man of the Church from introducing himself, from his own reason or understanding, into the Divine things of the Word... But at its end, when the men of the Church are... merely sensuous, and there is consequently no way from the spiritual man into the natural, these guards are removed, and the ways are opened; and in these opened ways they advance in a contrary order, which is done by means of reasonings from fallacies; and from this it happens that the man of the Church speaks in favour of Divine things... but thinks against them... Treated of.
Teach me Thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in Thy Truth () = teach truth according to which we must live...
Blessed is everyone that... walketh in His ways () = that lives according to Divine truths.
I will give them one heart and one way, to fear Me () = one will and one understanding to worship the Lord... Way = the truth of the understanding leading.
Go ye not in the way () = that at such a time... the things of doctrine are not to be consulted when taking counsel for one's self.
The way of Egypt () = the scientifics of the natural man, from which reasonings are effected.
Upon the ways hast thou sat, as an Arabian in the wilderness () = to insidiate lest anything of truth should come forth and be received. Ways = the truths of the Church.
As a leopard will I watch upon the way () = the falsification of truth through reasonings from the natural man; way = truth leading to good; and to watch = the intention to pervert it.
I will make straight all his ways () = the truths which proceed from good.

The reason ways = truths, is that truths lead man, like ways; and therefore ways = truths leading; (for) in the Spiritual World all walk in ways according to their truths. The ways there are not like the ways in this world - levelled and fixed from place to place to the Societies with which they are to be conjoined, or from those from which they are to be separated, and finally to the Society in which they will remain permanently.

These ways, through which the Lord leads man, may be compared to the vessels through which the blood circulates... and also to the fibres and their twinings within and without the viscera, especially in the brain... Yet the ways through which the Lord leads man are far more complicated and inextricable; both those ways through which He leads man through the Societies of Hell, and away from them; and also those ways through which He leads him through the Societies of Heaven, and more interiorly into them. Treated of.

For these (internal means of reformation) enter by an internal way, and cast out evils and falsities... But external means enter by an external way, and do not cast them out, but shut them in. Explained.

5. Two ways were presented to my view; one was called the way of wisdom, and the other the way of folly. Described. (Out of three hundred of the learned) two hundred and sixty entered the way of folly; and only forty the way of wisdom. Described.

3a. (Otherwise) a man sees no way of egress from Hell, and no way of entrance into Heaven; for truths must teach these... And as the way to Heaven or to Hell is from the world, and as man's life is in the world... it follows that this life is the way which the truths teach; and therefore if the man's life is in accordance with the truths of the Word, the way to Hell and from Hell is closed, and the way to the Lord and from the Lord is opened... This is what is meant by, I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life (). But if the man's life is contrary to the truths of the Word, the way from Heaven and to Heaven is closed, and the way to Hell and from Hell is opened, and the man's life becomes... death.

Enlightenment through the Word takes place by an interior way; but enlightenment by immediate revelation, by an exterior way. The interior way is through the will into the understanding; the exterior way is through the hearing into the understanding.
